blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts
blueprint.competency_task: Identifies the molecular driver connecting a clonal neoplasm to multisystem manifestations.

difficulty.rationale: Requires integration of discriminating clinical clues with a mechanism or diagnosis rather than isolated fact recall.

option_audit.correct: Explains the clonal mast-cell phenotype and is the most common molecular driver of systemic mastocytosis.
option_audit.JAK2: A plausible myeloid-neoplasm driver but points to PV/ET/PMF, not a mast-cell-predominant syndrome.
option_audit.FIP1L1_PDGFRA: A strong kinase distractor for eosinophilic neoplasms, but not the best explanation for this mastocytosis phenotype.
option_audit.BCR_ABL1: Drives CML/selected ALL rather than systemic mastocytosis.
option_audit.NF1: RAS disinhibition does not explain the characteristic KIT/CD117-positive mast-cell disorder.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Mediator symptoms, urtication of pigmented lesions, persistent tryptase elevation and multifocal CD117/CD25-positive spindle mast-cell aggregates identify systemic mastocytosis; constitutively activating KIT signaling, most commonly KIT D816V, is the canonical molecular driver.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: FIP1L1-PDGFRA is a legitimate tyrosine-kinase neoplasm distractor, especially when eosinophilia is prominent, but this vignette is a clonal mast-cell phenotype with classic mastocytosis markers and no eosinophilic syndrome.
adversarial_second_pass.other_distractors: JAK2 V617F maps to classic myeloproliferative neoplasms; BCR-ABL1 to CML/selected ALL; NF1 loss to RAS-pathway tumor predisposition rather than the described mast-cell neoplasm.
adversarial_second_pass.wording_check: The answer says D816V is the most common driver, not that every case carries it; this avoids overclaiming.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: The stem deliberately says tryptase is persistently elevated without asserting an unnecessary numerical threshold.
